intent: Allow a capability-selected neutral Loom worker to clone the private fleet Gitea mirror without ambient credentials or credential-bearing URLs.

wire_contract.encryption: NIP-44 to the selected worker pubkey
wire_contract.clone_url: credential-free HTTPS URL on the configured fleet Gitea origin

credential_model: A separately configured, service-scoped, read-only fleet Gitea credential is resolved by opaque UUID and is not reused from upstream mirror provisioning or fleet administration.
